description: CLMS Vegetated Land Cover Characteristics product filename per the CLMS Filenaming Framework (extension optional).

product.description: Product code (HR prefix dropped per CLMS Framework convention)

variable.description: Layer code hyphen-appended to the product code (e.g., GRA, CTY, DLT, GRAMD1, CPBSACL)

temporal_coverage.description: Temporal coverage token where CYYYY or CYYYY-YYYY captures change layers, PYYYY-YYYY captures period aggregates, and SYYYY captures status layers

tile_id.description: Tile identifier in the EEA 10m grid (easting/northing) or two-letter geographic code

oneOf.title: INSPIRE ETRS89-LAEA Grid
oneOf.description: Regional LAEA grid tile identifier (2- or 3-digit coordinates)

oneOf.title: Geographic code
oneOf.description: Two-letter geographic code used by VLCC vector products

epsg_code.description: Bare EPSG code of the product grid, no zero-padding (e.g., 3035)

version_revision.description: Single hyphenated version+revision token (R = Revision, not Release)
